title: Charillus
summary: Raleigh names Charillus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Charillus, named with his sonne Nicander for the times by which the age of Homer is proued. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. VII, sig. 291b–292a
